regions.purpose: Names the Review being authored — the Location, within its Collection's context — and holds Cancel, which discards the draft.
The Collection template's ordered fields, each rendered as an editable input for its type. The user fills and clears values here; the draft starts pre-filled with sensible defaults on entry.
Holds Save, which commits the draft Review and advances to the Collection Entry.

shows: the field's required marker, when the template author flagged it
the field's current draft value, rendered as an editable input for its type — stars, text, enum, boolean, date, power-ranking

lists.emptyState: When the Collection's template has no fields, the form has nothing to fill and points the user toward editing the template in CollectionEditor.
